aliases: salesforce certified marketing cloud account engagement specialist
certification_name: Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist

sub_objectives: Given a scenario, apply the appropriate plan of action using Prospect Audits.
objectives.title: Describe the relationship between visitors and prospects.
Illustrate how to create, edit, and map fields.
Explain the relationship between Account Engagement and Salesforce.
Describe the capabilities of the Account Engagement Recycle Bin.

domains.id: Account Engagement Forms, Form Handlers and Landing Pages
domains.name: Account Engagement Forms, Form Handlers and Landing Pages

objectives.title: Given a scenario, identify the capabilities, use cases and interpret metrics of Account Engagement forms.
Identify the capabilities, use cases and interpret reporting metrics for landing pages.
Explain the components and use cases of an automation rule.
Distinguish between the capabilities of, use cases for, and how to create different types of lists.
Define the capabilities of a completion action.
Define the capabilities of a segmentation rule.
Define the capabilities of page actions.
Explain what a Score measures and how scoring is managed.
Explain what a Grade measures and how grading is managed.
Identify the capabilities and use cases of custom redirects.
Distinguish between an Email and an Email Template.
Given a scenario, identify the capabilities and use cases for email.
Distinguish between the metrics collected in Account Engagement email reporting.
Distinguish between the components of an engagement program.
Explain the process of updating an engagement program including its assets.

exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. No access to Salesforce org. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-14: Trailhead credential page 'Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist' (the Pardot Specialist exam under its current name) live; no retirement wording; the 2027 FAQ retires the Account Engagement CONSULTANT (row 13), not the Specialist.

official_study_resources.notes: Free official learning platform with trails aligned to each certification
official_study_resources.title: Salesforce Trailhead

official_study_resources.notes: Free exam guides with sample questions on each credential page
official_study_resources.title: Salesforce Exam Guide & Sample Questions

recommended_experience: 6-12 months of experience building and executing marketing end-to-end workflows with the Account Engagement platform
renewal_options: Salesforce releases three major updates per year. For each release, certified professionals must complete a free maintenance module on Trailhead to retain their certification. No cost for maintenance.

retake_policy.notes: Retake available after scheduling (no mandatory waiting period for first retake). Retake fee ~$100 for most exams.

target_audience: Individuals who have experience using the capabilities of the Account Engagement platform, including practical application of the skills and concepts noted in the exam objectives

testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Kryterion Webassessor
